grammar.title: 语法知识 物主代词 & belong to
lines: 物主代词 形容词性 名词性 物主代词 形容词性 名词性
我的 my mine 我们的 our ours
你的 your yours 你们的 your yours
他的 his his 他们的 their theirs
她的 her hers
它的 its its
形容词性物主代词 + n. 名词性物主代词 （作主语、表语、宾语）
This is her car. My coat is green. It is my address. The car is her car. → The car is hers . The address is my address → The address is mine .
形容词性物主代词 复数 + n. 名词性物主代词 复数 （作主语、表语、宾语）
These are their names. This is our address in Beijing. This is your air ticket to London. These names are theirs . This address in Beijing is ours . Yours is to London, too.
物主代词 belong to

These are their keys to the car . 这是他们的车钥匙 These keys to the car are their s . 这些车钥匙是他们的。 It is his phone number. The phone number is his . These keys to the car belong to them. 这些车钥匙 属于 他们。 The phone number belongs to him.
否定 疑问

The address is not mine . The address not belongs to me . The address doesn’t belong to me. Are these letters yours ? Are these your letters? Are these letters belong to you? Do these letters belong to you?

sentences.title: 单词句型 belong to 练习
lines: 3 Are these their keys? = Are these keys their s ? Is this your letter? = Is this letter your s ?
These things belong to my husband. → They are his .
This coat belongs to me. → It is mine.
These shoes belong to my wife. → They are hers.
These books belong to my brother and me. → They are ours.
These pens belong to Tom and Jill. → The pens are theirs.
This suitcase belongs to you. → It is yours.
Do these keys belong to them?
Does this letter belong to you?
